Based on your waist measurement of 70 cm, size **M** is the match (waist 70 cm) [1].

Bust and hips matter too. Size M is bust 88 cm and hips 96 cm. If your bust or hip measurements fall between two sizes, the recommendation is to order the larger size [1].

If your measurements don't fit neatly into one size, any dress can be tailored to your exact measurements. This costs an extra 1,500 MKD and adds 7 working days to delivery [1].

results.answer:
Delivery to Kosovo normally takes 4 to 6 working days [1]. Custom tailoring adds 7 working days to the delivery time [3][4]. So a tailored dress sent to Kosovo should arrive in about **11 to 13 working days**.

Some other details that may help:
- You'll receive a tracking number by email on the day your order ships [2].
- Orders placed after 14:00 are shipped the next working day [2].
- Shipping to Kosovo costs 400 MKD, and tailoring costs an extra 1,500 MKD [1][4].

The sources don't say whether the 7 tailoring days are counted before the order ships or at some other point, so I can't give you an exact arrival date.
